name: HRV Baseline Deviation Calculator
description: Compare today's heart-rate variability reading with a personal baseline and quantify the percentage deviation.
search_intent: Calculate how far a current HRV reading differs from a personal HRV baseline.
calculation: Absolute difference = current HRV − baseline HRV. Percentage deviation = (current HRV − baseline HRV) ÷ baseline HRV × 100. Ratio = current HRV ÷ baseline HRV. Direction reports above, below or equal to baseline. Baseline must be greater than zero. Do not classify readings as healthy, unhealthy, recovered or overtrained.
limitations: HRV varies by measurement method, device, time of day, sleep and many personal factors.
Changes from baseline do not by themselves diagnose health, recovery, stress or overtraining.
Compare readings measured under consistent conditions.
